description: SimpleChat model capability catalog. Capability flags inform task-specific eligibility alongside provider adapters and publication policy; optional model token-limit fields are consumed by durable tabular batch planning when present.

capabilityFields.processesImages: Accepts image input for vision or image understanding.
capabilityFields.generatesImages: Produces native/direct image output through an image model/API; distinct from orchestrating an image generation tool.
capabilityFields.imageGenerationTool: Verified support for orchestrating the hosted image_generation tool in the Responses API, not native image output or vision. Deployment, provider, region, API version, and image-backend prerequisites still apply.
capabilityFields.processesAudio: Accepts audio input or supports speech/audio understanding.
capabilityFields.processesVideo: Accepts video input or documented video-clip summarization input.
capabilityFields.processesBinaryFiles: Accepts uploaded files or binary/document payloads through the provider API.
capabilityFields.optimizedForCoding: Documented or positioned for coding, agentic software tasks, code generation, or code understanding.
capabilityFields.toolCalling: Supports function/tool calling or provider-equivalent tool use.
capabilityFields.structuredOutput: Supports structured outputs, JSON-schema outputs, or provider-equivalent constrained structured responses.

coverageNotes: OpenAI coverage includes GPT-5.x model IDs seen through Foundry, older Responses orchestration models, and direct GPT Image models.

Image-generation tool metadata was checked against official model-specific Supported tools documentation on 2026-09-08. Generic function calling, image input, and inclusion in a Responses model list alone do not establish hosted image-generation support; a false or omitted flag means it is not verified for this integration.

OpenAI model pages describe api.openai.com, not Azure deployment readiness. Azure requires its v1 Responses surface for the hosted image tool; the dated 2025-04-01-preview Responses contract is not equivalent to v1. Direct Images API versions are a separate contract.

Azure lists GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna version 2026-07-09 for Responses. Its image-tool examples may require a deployed GPT Image backend and the x-ms-oai-image-generation-deployment header. Catalog support does not promise deployment-free routing, entitlement, region availability, or a successful live request.

Azure -chat entries are not automatically equated with OpenAI -chat-latest model IDs. OpenAI's documented tools for a similarly named chat snapshot do not establish the Azure entry's image tool support.

Capabilities classify model behavior, not live availability. New legacy/deprecated/retired entries describe the cited API lifecycle; OpenAI retirement dates do not automatically apply to Azure. Retained DALL-E compatibility must not be interpreted as an operational service.
Claude coverage includes current, legacy, deprecated, and recently retired Claude models that fall within the requested two-year window.
Meta coverage focuses on public Llama model families with clear model cards for text, vision, and coding support.
xAI coverage includes Grok chat/coding models plus documented Imagine and Voice model SKUs.
Microsoft coverage includes public Phi and MAI model cards with clear capability statements.
